project_description: Simplify Go-LIP's request receive and terminal execution architecture by decomposing the current retryRecvStream distributed God object into explicit private owners for current-attempt resources, retry/recovery state, response-event processing, and logical-turn terminal settlement. Preserve EventStream behavior, pre/post-commit failover, A/B-leg lifecycle, usage authority, billing, metering, secure-session recording, model-view pinning, interleaved thinking, tool repair, prompt-cache observations, extension hooks, and exact terminal semantics. The goal is structural deletion and reduced mutable ownership/coupling, not file splitting, interface proliferation, or a renamed universal TurnContext. This is architecture simplification tranche 1 and intentionally leaves request preparation/candidate-open state-bag convergence to the chronologically following request-attempt-pipeline-state-simplification specification.
